fields.name: unused head
fields.meaning: not touched by the game (zero in every state)
fields.evidence: blank card image is all zero; the format fill starts at 0x0010 (f000:42a4); zero in formatted and saved states

fields.name: work area (not save data)
fields.meaning: scratch memory: cleared to zero at every power-on that finds a valid signature; filled with the word 1000 when the cartridge is first formatted; never read back as save data
fields.evidence: code f000:419b (clear 0x10..0x53DF), f000:42a4 (format fill); diff of blank vs formatted card (fill 00 10)

fields.name: last-saved byte
fields.meaning: bits 0-1 = number of the FILE (1-3) saved last; bit 7 = the AUTO file has been saved; bits 2-6 kept as they were. Copied to RAM at power-on
fields.evidence: code d000:2113-212a (written after each successful save), f000:4269 (read at boot into RAM 0864); diffs: 00->01 after saving FILE 01, 00->02 after saving FILE 02; boot read trace (f000:426d)

fields.name: new-game flag byte
fields.meaning: OR-ed into the first event-flag byte when a new game starts; nothing writes it except the format fill (so a formatted cartridge holds 0x10 here and every new game starts with event flag 4 set)
fields.evidence: code d000:1d19 (read in new-game setup d000:1cb0), f000:42a4 (only writer, format fill); boot read trace (d000:1d1c); value 0x10 in all formatted states

fields.name: slot 0 main copy (AUTO)
fields.meaning: save file AUTO: an exact copy of game RAM 0500-0863 (0x362 bytes of game state + 2-byte checksum); layout below, offsets relative to the slot start
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b0 entry 0 (verified in the ROM file); written only by the silent auto-save e000:38b0 (slot 0); empty (all zero) in every state

fields.name: slot 1 main copy (FILE 01)
fields.meaning: save file FILE 01: an exact copy of game RAM 0500-0863 (0x362 bytes of game state + 2-byte checksum); layout below, offsets relative to the slot start
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b0 entry 1 (verified in the ROM file); saving FILE 01 wrote 0x5746-0x5AA9; the verified natural save loads it

fields.name: slot 2 main copy (FILE 02)
fields.meaning: save file FILE 02: an exact copy of game RAM 0500-0863 (0x362 bytes of game state + 2-byte checksum); layout below, offsets relative to the slot start
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b0 entry 2 (verified in the ROM file); a second natural save to FILE 02 wrote 0x5AAA-0x5E0D with a valid checksum, byte-identical to the FILE 01 save of the same game state

fields.name: slot 3 main copy (FILE 03)
fields.meaning: save file FILE 03: an exact copy of game RAM 0500-0863 (0x362 bytes of game state + 2-byte checksum); layout below, offsets relative to the slot start
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b0 entry 3 (verified in the ROM file); empty in every state

fields.name: slot 0 backup copy (AUTO)
fields.meaning: second copy of the same file, written right after the main copy; used at power-on to repair a damaged main copy
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b8 entry 0 (verified in the ROM file); d000:2086 writes it after the main copy; f000:4160 restores from it

fields.name: slot 1 backup copy (FILE 01)
fields.meaning: second copy of the same file, written right after the main copy; used at power-on to repair a damaged main copy
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b8 entry 1 (verified in the ROM file); d000:2086 writes it after the main copy; f000:4160 restores from it; the FILE 01 save wrote 0x64D6-0x6839 with bytes identical to its main copy

fields.name: slot 2 backup copy (FILE 02)
fields.meaning: second copy of the same file, written right after the main copy; used at power-on to repair a damaged main copy
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b8 entry 2 (verified in the ROM file); d000:2086 writes it after the main copy; f000:4160 restores from it; the FILE 02 save wrote 0x683A-0x6B9D with bytes identical to its main copy

fields.name: slot 3 backup copy (FILE 03)
fields.meaning: second copy of the same file, written right after the main copy; used at power-on to repair a damaged main copy
fields.evidence: code: ROM table f000:61b8 entry 3 (verified in the ROM file); d000:2086 writes it after the main copy; f000:4160 restores from it

fields.name: unused tail
fields.meaning: between the last backup copy and the signature; fill pattern only
fields.evidence: diffs across blank, formatted and saved states (format fill only)

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: text "HUNTERxHUNTER IV"; if it does not match the game formats the cartridge (all save files lost)
fields.evidence: code f000:417f compares with ROM f000:6190, f000:42ac writes it; boot read trace (f000:4187)

fields.name: program version
fields.meaning: text "rom0329-", rewritten from ROM at every power-on

fields.name: save layout version
fields.meaning: text "ram0307-"; a mismatch also formats the cartridge (old text kept at 0x7008)
fields.evidence: code f000:4194, f000:4298; boot read trace (f000:4196)

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: never written in any state (0x7008-0x700F only after a layout-version mismatch)
fields.evidence: diffs across all states; code f000:4298
